description: This PHP source file defines the class ProjectListViewData, which extends ListViewData and provides functionality related to displaying additional details in a list view, specifically for project records within SuiteCRM. It includes a method for generating AJAX-based detail spans with some embedded HTML and JavaScript hooks.

classes.name: ProjectListViewData
classes.description: A class extending ListViewData, intended to support the display of additional project record details via AJAX in the list view.

methods.name: getAdditionalDetailsAjax
methods.description: Returns an HTML span element with embedded JavaScript for triggering an AJAX request to retrieve additional project details, identified by the given record ID.
